answer: Use a published interest rate benchmark as a shared anchor: each agent must reference the current signed benchmark rate when stating any lending or yield claim, and verifiers check it against the benchmark publisher's feed. Forged accounts fail because the benchmark is one public number per day, so a thousand fake identities all citing it must still produce distinct, consistent positions around the karst of that single rate; the relic of past published rates leaves an audit trail, and no claim can wander away from the official series without being caught.
